translations.Can not impersonate. Please contact your: Pe twero donyo calo latic mukene. Tim ber ikube ki laloc me server mamegi wek oye ni idony calo lutic mukene.
translations.Can not impersonate: Pe twero donyo calo latic mukene
translations.Can not impersonate a disabled user: Pe twero donyo calo latic ma kijuko
translations.Can not impersonate a user who has never: Pe twero donyo calo latic ma pe odonyo iyie kadi kicel
translations.Do you want to log in as user \"{user}\": Imito donyo iyie calo latic “{user}”? Jami ducu ma itimo nio ka ikat woko kitimo calo latic man.
translations.The result of the request is unknown. Th: Adwogi me kwac pe ngene. Ki bi nwo cano pot buk me nyuto ni idonyo iyie calo latic mene.
translations.The impersonation settings could not be: Pe kitwero gwoko ter me donyo calo latic mukene. Ki bi nwo cano pot buk me nyuto ter ma tye ka tic kombedi.
translations.A group whose id contains \"|\" can not: Pe kitwero yero kany gurup ma ID-ne tye ki “|”. Ki bi nwo cano pot buk.
translations.Impersonate Settings: Ter me donyo calo latic mukene
translations.The group admin feature of this server i: Tic me luloc me gurup i server man kijuko (config.php: 'allow_subadmins' => false), pi meno luloc keken aye twero donyo calo lutic mukene. Ket 'allow_subadmins' => true me tic ki yer me luloc me gurup.
translations.Only an administrator is allowed to impe: Laloc keken aye twero donyo calo lutic mukene
translations.Allow all group admins to impersonate us: Wek luloc me gurup ducu gudony calo lutic ma i gurup ma giloyo
translations.Allow group admins of specific groups to: Wek luloc me gurup ma kiyero gudony calo lutic ma i gurup magi
translations.Also in the list, but not editable here: Gurup mukene bene kiyero, ento pe kitwero yubo kany pien ID-gi tye ki “|”: %s
translations.Allow group admins to impersonate member: Wek luloc me gurup gudony calo lutic ma gin kikomgi bene luloc me gurup
translations.Such a member may administer other group: Latic macalo meno twero loyo gurup mukene. Laloc me gurup ma odonyo calo en bene bi tic ki twero magi.
translations.An impersonation ends after %s minutes a: Kare me donyo calo latic mukene pe kato dakika %s (ter me purugram “max_duration_minutes”).
translations.The duration of an impersonation is not: Kare me donyo calo latic mukene pe kigiko (ter me purugram “max_duration_minutes” obedo 0).
translations.Refused during an impersonation in addit: Yo ma kigengo i kare me donyo calo latic mukene, me medo i kom yo ma dong kiketo i purugram (ter me purugram “forbidden_prefixes”): %s
translations.Entries of the app config \"forbidden_pr: Jami me ter me purugram “forbidden_prefixes” ma pe obedo acakki me yo calo “/apps/someapp/” ci kiweko woko: %s
translations.\"%s\" was revoked for security reasons: “%s” kikwanyo pi ber bedo i agikki me donyo calo in. Ka in kikomi aye icweyo, tim ber icwe odoco.
translations.The session \"%s\" of your account was e: Kare me tic “%s” me akaunt mamegi kitumo pi ber bedo i agikki me donyo calo in. Ka onongo obedo kare me tic mamegi kikomi, tim ber idony iyie odoco.
translations.The URL signing key of your account was: Lagony me keto cing i URL me akaunt mamegi kikwanyo pi ber bedo i agikki me donyo calo in. Ki bi cweyo lagony manyen ka mite.
